steps.title: Define App Specifications and Architecture for Modern Calculator
steps.description: Establish key requirements for the high-end dark calculator, unit converter, and calculation history log.

steps.title: Configure Android Build Environment (Gradle 8.5 & AGP 8.3.2)
steps.description: Set up project-level configurations adhering to target SDK 34 and Java 17 requirements.

steps.title: Set Up Android Application Manifest with Proper Launch Configuration
steps.description: Formulate AndroidManifest.xml with correct package names, launch actions, and custom hardware acceleration flags.

steps.title: Design Custom Sleek Dark Theme Color Palette
steps.description: Define deep rich dark charcoal background hues and vibrant active blue, orange, and light-grey accent color values.

steps.title: Create Rounded Button & Card Selector Drawables for Calculator UI
steps.description: Design sleek modern rounded XML selectors with active pressed states for number, operator, and action keys.

steps.title: Implement Modern Segmented Tab Bar for Layout Navigation
steps.description: Create horizontal layout controls representing elegant segment tabs: Calculator, Converter, and History.

steps.title: Develop Responsive Layouts for Calculator, Unit Converter, and History Panels
steps.description: Build high-performance, non-overlapping layouts styled optimally with custom card margins and elegant spacing.

steps.title: Implement Robust Mathematical Expression Parser in Java
steps.description: Write a highly precise recursive descent parser in MainActivity supporting brackets, operator precedence, fractions, and percentage values.

steps.title: Program Unit Converter Engine Supporting Length, Temperature, and Weight
steps.description: Build responsive math conversions mapping various measurement systems in real-time.

steps.title: Build SharedPreferences History Storage and Retrieval Logic
steps.description: Integrate persistence routines to save previous calculation results and reload them dynamically on demand.

steps.title: Implement Haptic Feedback, State Restoration, and User Interactions
steps.description: Hook up keyboard vibration cues, clear input indicators, dialog boxes, and visual transitions.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile, validate package layout, assemble source binaries, and test execution integrity.
